title: Rough rock and rubble face template
purpose: Measure rough-surface completeness, noise, edge preservation, and color registration without claiming material identity.

deviceEnvironment.deviceModel: LiDAR-capable iPhone Pro; record exact identifier per run
deviceEnvironment.operatingSystem: iOS 18 or later; record exact build per run

lighting.description: Recorded diffuse and oblique illumination with no unrecorded relighting

orderedInstructions: Capture the measured face from a frontal position.
Sweep with overlapping oblique views at two heights.
Revisit the central reference patch before finishing.
